rubric.2: Visible match to the main entity and the explicit action, color, position or relation; simple subject queries require only the entity.
rubric.1: Related main entity is present, but an explicit condition is missing, contradicted or not visually confirmable in a still image.
rubric.0: Main non-person target is absent or the image is unrelated. For person-position queries the person is the target.
rubric.reviewer: Assistant visual review of original-image contact sheets, with individual originals inspected where needed. These are provisional visual judgments, not external dataset annotations or an independent human gold standard.

notes.S02: Rank 3 (153217) is a black cat by a motorcycle, confirmed from the original image, not a dog.
notes.S04: Motorcycles are retrieved for bicycle. Original rank 3 shows bicycles carried on a motorcycle; rank 6 contains a partial bicycle at the bottom left. Both contain actual bicycles.
notes.A01: Motorcycle and skateboard confusion; parked bicycles and people standing beside bicycles do not establish riding.
notes.A02: Bodyboarding is accepted as surfing. Rank 5 does not clearly establish the activity in the review image.
notes.A03: Running vs walking, standing and jumping is ambiguous in single frames. Grade 1 is used when running is not clearly established, including rank 1 beach dog.
notes.A04: Holding vs merely sitting under an umbrella is distinguished; original rank 4 umbrella rests on the table, and rank 7 is a kite.
notes.A05: Eating, holding food, cooking with a spatula and serving food are not equivalent to cutting with a knife; rank 1 original has utensils held over food; rank 10 original shows grating, not knife cutting.
notes.E01: Position is a qualitative judgment in the full original image: main target clearly near a side border (including visibly side-clipped body), not a centrally placed close-up. Borderline locations are partial. Most results match dog but ignore edge position. Rank 3 is a cat.
notes.E02: Right side means target center in the rightmost third; at least one visibly standing person suffices, including distant people. Several results contain no person at all.
notes.E03: Small means small in the frame, not a small aircraft type; use approximate target bounding-box area at most 10% of image. Kites are not airplanes.
notes.E04: Small bird is evaluated relative to the frame (roughly <=10% area), with outdoor surroundings visible. Rank 8 is a stuffed teddy bear on a fence, confirmed in original.
notes.E05: Near top means traffic-light center in the upper third of the full frame. Stop signs and hydrants are not traffic lights; original rank 7 shows illuminated road signs, not a confirmed traffic light.
notes.C01: Red must belong to a substantial part of the bus body. A yellow bus beside a red car is only partial relevance.
notes.C02: Yellow skin must be visible. Green bananas and a completely peeled banana are partial; yellow clothing or a truck is unrelated.
notes.C03: Black and white must both be visible on the cat, not merely a black cat or a brown/white tabby. A visible depicted cat is accepted because the query does not specify a live animal. Rank 8 is a dog.
notes.C04: Blue must be visible on a train. Black-and-white photos or unclear train color are partial. Background blue trains count when visible.
notes.C05: Red must belong to a car, not a train, bus or parking meter. Cars of another color are partial relevance.
notes.R01: Plate/table/windowsill/steps are not a chair; under an upside-down chair is not sitting on it. No fully matching candidate is confirmed in the reviewed pool; this does not establish absence from all 1000 images.
notes.R02: Walking and lying down are not confirmed standing. Rank 6 is a cat; rank 7 original has no visible dog. Separated sheepdogs and shepherd are partial.
notes.R03: A saddled horse alone is partial; riding an elephant, a skateboard or a motorcycle is unrelated to the horse target.
notes.R04: Both a cup and a plate of food must be on the table and adjacent. Banana on a plate alone is partial; original rank 10 has plates but no clearly visible cup.
notes.R05: Rank 1 bicycle leans against a sofa, not clearly a wall; rank 2 is hanging on a train wall. Neither establishes leaning against a wall. No full match confirmed in reviewed pool.
